correctness.rationale: For every m>=2, correct treatment of vacancy endpoints and post-move neighborhoods yields necessary/sufficient opposite-endpoint and run-length conditions. Counting runs separately gives k from ceil((m+1)/2) to m and each 2(2m+1) C(k-1,m-k)^2. Boundary utilities turn 2k-1 unlike edges into welfare 2k; alternating colors attain the optimum 2m. Standalone exact enumeration for all placements m<=7 checked both direction of Nash equivalence and formulas; finite tests do not replace algebraic proof. Independent audit not performed.
